searched: Searched the existing-claims inventory for every person and organisation named in the brief and found here (Brockman, Karnofsky, Karpathy, Metz, Zoph, Weng, Scandinaro, Kosic, Jumper and others). Web searches (discovery only) for 2023–2026 moves into, out of and between OpenAI and Anthropic: Brockman's 2024 sabbatical and return; Karnofsky at Anthropic; Tim Brooks to Google DeepMind; Logan Kilpatrick to Google; Andrea Vallone to Anthropic; Sam Schoenholz's return; OpenAI researchers to Meta Superintelligence Labs and back (Beyer, Kolesnikov, Zhai, Jason Wei, Hyung Won Chung, Verma, Knight, Metz); Google DeepMind researchers to Anthropic (Carlini, Jumper, Houlsby, Sohl-Dickstein, Anil); 2026 moves (Schwarzer, Karpathy, Tworek, Steinberger, Dean Ball); xAI to OpenAI (Ruddarraju, Liberatore); Microsoft to OpenAI (Bubeck); Sachin Katti; Alec Radford. X posts were read through X's syndication endpoint (which truncates long notes and cannot read image notes); company pages and reports directly or through the reader relay. The relay was intermittently blocked (HTTP 401) for this IP, which defeated Axios, GeekWire and DCD; The Verge and LinkedIn were not attempted as evidence. Primary texts were used wherever retrieved; 15 records rest on reporting and say so.
